task: subdoc-qa-mvp phase 05 LLM AI lane (review fix cycle after Stage 2 security review)
method: STRIDE pass by the execute agent over the review findings; the scenarios the Stage 2 review left not-ruled-out (M1-M3, L1-L3) are now covered by named regression tests

scenarios.scenario: Model cites a real candidate id but quotes a sentence from elsewhere in the document to plant a finding on a different clause
scenarios.rationale: M1: quote located only inside the cited candidate site (llm-quote-scoped-to-candidate 'elsewhere')

scenarios.scenario: Model returns a one-word or tiny quote that trivially matches anywhere
Hallucinated quote or unknown candidate id becomes a finding
scenarios.rationale: quote_not_found for unknown ids and absent quotes (hostile-hallucinated recording + ghost test)

scenarios.scenario: Firm rule text used to remove/downgrade issues
scenarios.rationale: rules are delimited untrusted context; AI severity capped at high; prompt states rules never filter (existing rules-injection tests)

scenarios.scenario: Visitor denies having used AI quota after an induced timeout
scenarios.rationale: M2: timeout keeps all claims; ledger/claims unchanged

scenarios.scenario: Raw account digits reach OpenRouter from a client that skipped masking
scenarios.rationale: L2: shapeAi server mask (shape-ai-server-mask upstream body test)

scenarios.scenario: Cross-workspace / cross-firm rule leakage into prompts
scenarios.rationale: workspace-bound RulesPort (rules-port-scoped, firm-rule-isolation); end-to-end re-verify tracked as I1 for Phase 08

scenarios.scenario: Visitor loops slow prompts to get free refunded upstream calls
Workspace creates thousands of active rules to blow D1 rows_read per AI call
scenarios.rationale: M3 LIMIT 101 (rows_read 101 measured) + 100-rule cap at create/approve

scenarios.scenario: Malicious/broken server streams an endless line to exhaust browser memory
Model returns a huge findings array to burn client/worker CPU
scenarios.rationale: L3 slice to aiCandidates*3 before per-item validation

scenarios.scenario: Truncated (finish_reason length) or non-free served model recorded as fixture and trusted
scenarios.rationale: L1 record-ai aborts; exact base-id equality
L4 open: Phase 08 computeGate must exclude detector_kind 'ai' (not yet implemented; gate does not exist yet)

scenarios.scenario: Unmasked counsel draft text shown in UI
